description: Gradient-equivalent scalar surrogate for the DMD generator update: sums -prediction times the detached precomputed s_real - s_fake score difference, with scores defined by Eq. (1), over event dimensions, then reduces over the batch (Improved Distribution Matching Distillation for Fast Image Synthesis, §3, Eqs. (1)–(2)).

examples.code:
import tempfile
import torch
from topologies import Trainer, build, synth
root = tempfile.mkdtemp()
@synth.generator
def score_differences(ctx):
    inputs = torch.randn(4, generator=ctx.rng.torch)
    targets = torch.randn(2, generator=ctx.rng.torch)
    return {"inputs": synth.Tensor(inputs), "targets": synth.Tensor(targets)}
dataset = synth.Spec("dmd2-score-differences", generator=score_differences, size=16, splits={"train": 0.75, "val": 0.25}, seed=7, root=root, monitor="none").run()
train = dataset.for_recipe("regression", split="train", input_field="inputs", target_field="targets", preserve_shape=True)
model = build("mlp", "tiny", in_features=4, out_features=2)
trainer = Trainer(model, train, recipe="regression", recipe_config={"loss": "dmd2"}, batch_size=4, max_epochs=1, device="cpu")
trainer.fit()
examples.title: Train a generator with DMD2 score-difference gradients

name: DMD2 gradient-equivalent distribution matching surrogate

parameters.additional parameters: unsupported; any extra keyword parameter raises ValueError
parameters.ignore_index: must be None because score-difference tensors have no ignored class or label index
parameters.logits_or_prediction: floating-point generator prediction tensor with a nonempty shape [B, ...]
parameters.reduction: none returns one scalar per sample after summing event dimensions; mean or sum reduces across the batch (default mean)
parameters.targets: floating-point precomputed s_real - s_fake score difference using the scores defined by §3, Eq. (1), with the same shape, dtype, and device as prediction; detached by the loss
